```ruby
class Band
  attr_reader :min, :max

  def initialize(min, max)
    raise ArgumentError, "min must be less than max" unless min < max
    @min = min
    @max = max
  end

  def matches?(number)
    number >= @min && number < @max
  end

  # Make Band usable in case/when via ===
  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(Band) && @min == other.min && @max == other.max
  end

  def eql?(other)
    self == other
  end

  def hash
    [@min, @max].hash
  end

  # The === operator is used by case/when statements
  def ===(other)
    return false unless other.is_a?(Numeric)
    matches?(other)
  end

  # For Enumerable#grep
  def to_proc
    ->(x) { matches?(x) }
  end
end
```

class Counter
  def initialize
    @value = 0
    @step = 1
  end

  attr_reader :value

  # Adds the counter's current step to its value and returns self.
  def bump
    @value += @step
    self
  end

  # Temporarily sets this counter's own step to +step+ for the duration of
  # the block. The previous step is restored when the block returns, whether
  # or not the block raises. This override applies ONLY to the single Counter
  # on which #with_step was called and never affects any other Counter
  # (including #dup/#clone copies).
  def with_step(step)
    previous_step = @step
    @step = step
    begin
      yield
    ensure
      @step = previous_step
    end
  end

  # Produces an independent copy. The copy starts with the same #value as
  # the original at the moment of copying. From that point on, #bump and
  # #with_step on either object never affect the other.
  def dup
    copy = Counter.new
    copy.instance_variable_set(:@value, @value)
    copy.instance_variable_set(:@step, @step)
    copy
  end

  # Like #dup, but also carries over the original's frozen state.
  def clone
    copy = dup
    copy.freeze if frozen?
    copy
  end
end

```ruby
class Proxy
  def initialize(target)
    @target = target
  end

  # Forward method calls to the target
  def method_missing(name, *args, **kwargs, &block)
    if @target.respond_to?(name)
      if kwargs
        @target.send(name, *args, **kwargs, &block)
      else
        @target.send(name, *args, &block)
      end
    else
      super
    end
  end

  # Respond to methods that the target responds to
  def respond_to?(name, include_all = false)
    super || @target.respond_to?(name, include_all)
  end

  # Provide method objects for methods that the target responds to
  def method(name)
    if respond_to?(name)
      method = super rescue nil
      return method if method
      if @target.respond_to?(name)
        lambda do |*args, **kwargs, &block|
          if kwargs
            send(name, *args, **kwargs, &block)
          else
            send(name, *args, &block)
          end
        end
      else
        super
      end
    else
      super
    end
  end
end
```
